results.command: node --experimental-transform-types scripts/source-stability.ts -- npx vitest run tests/gp-selected-path-lifecycle.test.ts

historicalAttempt.cause: Test-only PathProbe method named sample collided with the existing AIDriver private sample field. Renamed selectedOffsetForReview; no production change.

nativeProbe.currentAndPreviewMargin: Existing base RACING_LINE.edgeMargin = 2.4 m, with local laneReach contract.

coverage: Unprojected selected current lane survives clipping at preview.
Both current and preview query the existing base local road bound.
Takeover rebases previous fixed-station point to actual placed lateral position.
Road selection invalidated during lights and reaction delay.
Bike rider-down early return invalidates selection.
Pit and pit-approach absolute corridors invalidate road selection.
NonGP steering ignores selected road metadata.

limitations: These native controls establish selected-path publication and lifecycle, not full-race acceptance.
Temporal/query consistency does not claim exact authored-curvature feed-forward on every clipped edge; that approximation was not changed.
